import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    // ModNum class
    static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;

    static long modInv(long a, long m) {
        if (m == 1) return 0;
        a %= m;
        if (a < 0) a += m;
        if (a == 0) throw new ArithmeticException("Inverse does not exist");
        if (a == 1) return 1;
        return m - modInv(m, a) * m / a;
    }

    static class ModNum {
        int val;

        ModNum() { val = 0; }
        ModNum(long v) {
            val = (int)(v % MOD);
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }

        ModNum inv() {
            long inv = modInv(val, MOD);
            return new ModNum(inv);
        }

        ModNum add(ModNum o) {
            int res = val + o.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModNum(res);
        }

        ModNum sub(ModNum o) {
            int res = val - o.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModNum(res);
        }

        ModNum mul(ModNum o) {
            long res = (long)val * o.val % MOD;
            return new ModNum(res);
        }

        ModNum div(ModNum o) {
            return this.mul(o.inv());
        }

        ModNum addEq(ModNum o) {
            val += o.val;
            if (val >= MOD) val -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModNum subEq(ModNum o) {
            val -= o.val;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModNum mulEq(ModNum o) {
            val = (int)((long)val * o.val % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        ModNum divEq(ModNum o) {
            return this.mulEq(o.inv());
        }

        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            ModNum modNum = (ModNum) o;
            return val == modNum.val;
        }

        public int hashCode() {
            return val;
        }
    }

    static ModNum num(long v) {
        return new ModNum(v);
    }

    static ModNum one = num(1);
    static ModNum zero = num(0);

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int readN = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int N = 6;
        ModNum[][] prob = new ModNum[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                prob[i][j] = zero;
            }
            prob[i][i] = one;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < readN; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < readN; j++) {
                int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                prob[i][j] = num(a).div(num(100));
            }
        }

        final int F = 20;
        List<Integer>[] msk = new List[2];
        msk[0] = new ArrayList<>();
        msk[1] = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                    int mask0 = (1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k);
                    msk[0].add(mask0);
                    int fullMask = (1 << N) - 1;
                    msk[1].add(fullMask ^ mask0);
                }
            }
        }
        // F == msk[0].size()

        int size = 1 << F;
        ModNum[][] dp = new ModNum[2][size];
        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                dp[t][j] = zero;
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            int halfN = N / 2; // 3
            int edgesCount = halfN * N; // 18
            int eMax = 1 << edgesCount;
            for (int e = 0; e < eMax; e++) {
                ModNum pval = one;
                int[] edges = new int[halfN];
                for (int i = 0; i < edgesCount; i++) {
                    boolean bit = ((e >> i) & 1) == 1;
                    int row = i / N;
                    int col = i % N;
                    ModNum pp = prob[row * 2 + t][col];
                    pval = pval.mul(bit ? pp : (one.sub(pp)));
                    if (bit) {
                        edges[row] |= (1 << col);
                    }
                }
                int wmask = 0;
                List<Integer> curMsk = msk[t];
                for (int a = 0; a < curMsk.size(); a++) {
                    int mask = curMsk.get(a);
                    int r0 = edges[0] & mask;
                    int r1 = edges[1] & mask;
                    int r2 = edges[2] & mask;
                    if (r0 != 0 && r1 != 0 && r2 != 0) {
                        int union = r0 | r1 | r2;
                        if (Integer.bitCount(union) == 3) {
                            int x = Integer.bitCount(r0 | r1);
                            int y = Integer.bitCount(r0 | r2);
                            int z = Integer.bitCount(r1 | r2);
                            if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
                                wmask |= (1 << a);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                dp[t][wmask] = dp[t][wmask].add(pval);
            }
        }

        // SOS DP on dp[0]
        for (int i = 0; i < F; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                if ((j >> i & 1) == 0) {
                    dp[0][j ^ (1 << i)] = dp[0][j ^ (1 << i)].add(dp[0][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        ModNum ans = zero;
        int fullMaskF = (1 << F) - 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
            ans = ans.add(dp[0][j].mul(dp[1][fullMaskF ^ j]));
        }
        ans = one.sub(ans);
        System.out.println(ans.val);
    }
}
